ctx.x: Well who had the pleasure club? All the musicians or who?

Yeah, the musicians in town pretty much all of them was in there. And when they broke up, I got the money back. I got more than what I had spent in there. I got more money back. And Willie Hoffer took the charter I believe for him and said, give me the charter, I'll take that for my pay. Well he was lucky, he took it and used to, got up a union, you see. And he got that charter, bought that charter from Willie Hoffer I believe, $25. Chris Kelly was living there.
Which time? When they had the pleasure club or when they had the union?
